title: Understanding the Sampling Frame
text: Consider what the sampling frame is in this scenario. The sampling frame is the list or method used to select individuals from the population. In this case, what is the sampling frame?

title: Identifying the Population of Interest
text: Think about who the population of interest is. Aditi and Zekai want to know about the chocolate milk preferences of a specific group. Who are they interested in?

title: Analyzing the Sampling Method
text: Aditi suggests selecting every fifth student in discussion sections. Is this method likely to include students who are in the population of interest?

title: Evaluating the Sampling Frame
text: Does the sampling frame (every fifth student in discussion sections) overlap with the population of interest (above-average spenders)?
